cards.answer: HMS Buttercup was involved in escorting a convoy of merchant ships across the North Atlantic during the war.
cards.quote: As the HMS Buttercup cut through the choppy waters of the North Atlantic, its crew of seasoned sailors and young recruits alike stood vigilant, scanning the horizon for any sign of the enemy. It was a chilly autumn morning in 1941, and the war was raging on. The Flower-class corvette, with its distinctive stern and sleek hull, had been tasked with escorting a convoy of merchant ships across the treacherous waters.

cards.claim: HMS Buttercup was involved in the cremation of Lieutenant Thompson at sea.
cards.answer: HMS Buttercup was involved in the cremation of Lieutenant Thompson at sea.
cards.quote: As he stood watch on the bridge, he noticed a peculiar sight - a small, makeshift pyre had been constructed on the deck, surrounded by a ring of solemn-faced sailors. "What's going on, mate?" Tom asked one of the older sailors, a grizzled veteran named Jenkins. "It's for poor old Lieutenant Thompson," Jenkins replied, his voice low and somber. "He didn't make it through the night. We're giving him a proper sendoff, out of respect."
